answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fake identities by making each one pass stranger checks. Each epoch, a beacon pairs an identity with three auditors; a violet flag on any mismatch in its work log opens a review. It locks 40 credits in a bond vault, and a confirmed fake loses it all, half burned and half paid to its auditors. A history as empty as tundra fails at once, and rented auditors vouching for fakes lose their bonds. The k-th fake still needs its bond and history, so 1,000 fakes risk 40,000 credits with no bulk discount, while an honest agent keeps its bond untouched.
